summary: [Meta Marketing API] objects: Meta Marketing API: AdAccount (act_*), Campaign, AdSet, Ad, AdCreative (object_story_spec: page_id + link_data/image_hash/CTA; or object_story_id for dark posts from existing page posts), Custom/Lookalike/Saved Audiences, LeadGen forms + Leads, Insights (impressions, spend, clicks, actions, breakdowns), Automated Rules, Pixels/datasets (CAPI).
